clock_policy: Unchanged cap and clock policy, dynamic GPU Boost; no clock locking or overclock.

GEMM.precision: Explicit accumulation type; output dtype specified separately; reduced-precision reduction disallowed.

H3.precision: BF16 linears with CPU group offload, not INT4
H3.instrumentation: Synchronization and full output hashing between forwards; included in generation duration.

boot_evidence: Full AD102 transaction gate before NVIDIA, then official RM getter full after driver and workload; later cold stock getter half and separately authorized repeated unlock full.
error_check: No Xid/BUG/Oops/panic/AER error matching the screened expressions in the completed measurement journals. Not a general stability certificate.
sanitization: GPU UUID, PCI target address, host names, boot/root UUIDs, private locations, model/embedding content and credentials omitted. Numeric samples/output digests preserved.
limits: One profile per stock/unlocked boot, not independent boot-level statistics.
Transient cgroup containment added for stock, no numerical configuration changed; stock service reported1.6G swap peak.
Precision comparison is not a full-H3 FP16 rollout.
One board; the primary GEMM/H3 comparison uses one stock and one unlocked boot.
No tensor-instruction microbenchmark/SASS proof in this contribution.
Private H3 input assets are not redistributed; manifests were compared internally.
LLM token equality is not logits equality; small throughput changes have no statistical significance estimate.
The separate experimental FP16 conversion is not included in the stock/unlocked evidence.
